summary: The diff largely implements the requested new 6-screen mini-game flow and most screen-specific mechanics, but several requirements are only partially met or have exact-text/animation-layering issues. There are also unrelated modifications to legacy screens/components that were not requested for this pivot.

missing_requirements.requirement: Intro screen must display exactly two text blocks: “Hi Anya 💕\nWelcome to a tiny game I made just for you.” and “Your mission: find the NO button 😌”.
missing_requirements.reason: The Intro screen splits the first required block into two separate elements (a standalone “Hi Anya 💕” heading and a separate “Welcome to a tiny game I made just for you.” paragraph), resulting in three text blocks rather than the specified two exact blocks.

missing_requirements.requirement: The Level 1 NO button must sometimes appear visually behind (partially occluded by) a teddy/flower/chocolate distraction element.
missing_requirements.reason: The NO button is rendered inside an interactive layer with `z-10`, while occluders are rendered with `z-5`, which would place occluders behind the NO button (not occluding it). Also, `z-5` is not a standard Tailwind z-index utility by default, so the intended layering may not apply.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each fake button must vanish when tapped with a lightweight animation before advancing to the Real Question screen.
missing_requirements.reason: Fake buttons are removed from view immediately by state filtering; the provided `animate-vanish-on-tap` class is applied, but the inline `style` sets `animation: 'none'` when visible, and once tapped the element is unmounted, so a vanish animation is not clearly executed before removal.

missing_requirements.requirement: Final celebration line must be exactly: “Happy Valentine’s Day 💕\nI’m really lucky to be with you.”
missing_requirements.reason: The implemented final message is “Happy Valentine's Day 💕\nI'm really lucky to be with you.” which uses different apostrophe characters (straight apostrophes vs curly) and does not match the exact required string.

missing_requirements.requirement: Incorporate the uploaded images into the app as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated (or equivalent) and use them in the UI.
missing_requirements.reason: The UI references multiple assets under `/assets/generated/...`, but the diff summary shows no added image files under a public assets path, so incorporation of the required images cannot be confirmed from the provided diff.

hallucinated_features.description: Changes to legacy/unused screens from the old flow (BuildUpScreen, BigQuestionScreen, SweetEndingScreen) despite the new App flow no longer using them by default.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focuses on replacing the flow with new mini-game screens; it does not request updates to the prior Build-up/Big Question/Sweet Ending screens.
